sentences.text: The claim runs in three steps: foreign aid takes a very large share of the federal budget, cutting it frees spending on that same scale, and the federal deficit narrows substantially.

Both joins between those steps are where this family of articles goes quiet. No member states the move from the share to the spending freed, and none states the move from that spending to the deficit.
Crossing the first join needs the line's annual outlay in dollars. Judging the second needs the size of the deficit itself. No source in the registry states either number.

Standing outside the frame: the organizations, commodity producers and freight carriers currently paid from the line, the people its programs serve at the point of delivery, and the signed obligations and goods in transit that keep drawing money after a cut lands.

The poll asked what share of the federal budget goes to foreign aid. Respondents averaged 26 percent; the poll states about 1 percent as the actual share. The panel reads the second against the first, since both are shares of the same budget, and about 1 percent is a small part of the size the claim asserts. No dollar amount sits on either bar, because no source in the registry states the budget total those shares are shares of.
Among respondents, 11 percent landed on that actual share. The support the poll records runs 58 percent before respondents are shown it and 34 percent after.

Klaim ini berjalan dalam tiga langkah: bantuan luar negeri memakan porsi sangat besar dari anggaran federal, memangkasnya membebaskan belanja pada skala yang sama, lalu defisit federal menyusut secara berarti.
Dua sambungan di antara langkah-langkah itu tidak dimuat oleh sumber mana pun dalam keluarga artikel ini, jadi rantainya berhenti dua kali sebelum sampai ke defisit.

Untuk melintasi sambungan pertama dibutuhkan belanja tahunan pos itu dalam dolar sebagai pembilang, dan untuk melintasi yang kedua dibutuhkan angka defisit yang menjadi dasar pembandingnya, sementara tidak ada anggota keluarga ini yang menyebut kedua angka tersebut.

Di luar bingkai berdiri lembaga pelaksana, produsen komoditas, dan pengangkut kargo yang kini dibayar dari pos itu, orang-orang yang dilayani program-program itu di titik layanan, serta kewajiban kontrak yang sudah diteken dan tidak kembali ke kas dalam tahun berjalan.

Jajak pendapat itu menanyakan berapa porsi anggaran federal yang mengalir ke bantuan luar negeri. Tebakan rata-rata responden 26 persen, sedangkan porsi aktual menurut jajak pendapat itu sekitar 1 persen. Panel skala membaca angka kedua terhadap angka pertama, karena keduanya porsi dari anggaran federal yang sama, dan sekitar 1 persen itu hanya sebagian kecil dari ukuran yang dinyatakan klaim tersebut. Tidak ada jumlah dolar pada kedua batangnya, sebab tidak ada sumber dalam registri yang menyebut total anggaran yang menjadi induk porsi-porsi itu.

Sebanyak 11 persen responden menebak jatuh tepat pada porsi aktual itu, dan dukungan yang dicatat jajak pendapat itu bergerak dari 58 persen sebelum porsi aktualnya ditunjukkan ke 34 persen sesudahnya.

q.en: A cut lands on the foreign aid line. According to the artifact, what sits between cutting the line and the Treasury actually stopping payments?
q.id: Pemangkasan jatuh pada pos bantuan luar negeri. Menurut artefak ini, apa yang berdiri di antara keputusan memangkas pos itu dan saat kas negara berhenti mengeluarkan pembayaran?

options.en: Nothing much: an appropriation cut stops the outflow the day it takes effect
options.id: Nyaris tidak ada: pemangkasan anggaran menghentikan aliran keluar pada hari aturannya berlaku.

options.en: Signed obligations already in place and goods already in transit, which keep drawing money after the cut lands
options.id: Kewajiban kontrak yang sudah diteken dan barang yang sudah dalam perjalanan, yang masih menarik uang setelah pemangkasan jatuh.

options.en: A confirming vote in Congress that has to clear before any payment pauses
options.id: Pemungutan suara penegasan di Kongres yang harus lolos sebelum pembayaran mana pun dijeda.

note.en: The claim map puts the already-obligated share of the line outside the frame. Between an appropriation and an outlay sit signed obligations and goods already in transit, residue that keeps drawing money after the cut lands. That is the step no member of the family follows: from cutting the line to what the Treasury actually stops paying, and when.
note.id: Peta klaim menempatkan bagian pos yang sudah terikat kontrak di luar bingkai. Di antara keputusan anggaran dan uang yang keluar berdiri kewajiban yang sudah diteken dan barang yang sudah dalam perjalanan, sisa yang masih menarik uang setelah pemangkasan jatuh. Langkah itulah yang tidak diikuti anggota mana pun dalam keluarga ini: dari memangkas pos sampai ke apa yang berhenti dibayar kas negara, dan kapan.

q.en: The scale check measures the share the poll states as the actual one against a base. Which base does the panel use?
q.id: Panel skala membaca porsi yang disebut jajak pendapat itu sebagai porsi aktual terhadap satu pembanding. Angka mana yang dipakai sebagai pembanding itu?

options.en: Federal receipts for fiscal year 2025, the dollar total in the Treasury statement
options.id: Penerimaan federal tahun fiskal 2025, total dolar dalam laporan Treasury.

options.en: The size the claim asserts: the 26 percent of the federal budget respondents averaged
options.id: Ukuran yang dinyatakan klaim itu sendiri, yaitu tebakan rata-rata responden sebesar 26 persen dari anggaran federal.

options.en: The federal budget total, in dollars, that both of the poll's shares are shares of
options.id: Total anggaran federal dalam dolar yang menjadi induk kedua porsi dari jajak pendapat itu.

note.en: The scale check settles it: the base is the size the claim asserts, the 26 percent of the federal budget respondents averaged. The share the poll gives as the actual one, about 1 percent, is read against that and comes out a small part of it, and the two can be read against each other because both are shares of the same budget. Neither bar carries a dollar amount. The panel says why: no source in the registry states the budget total those shares are shares of, and federal receipts for the year, which the Treasury statement does carry, are a different total from the budget a budget share is a share of.
note.id: Panel skala menyelesaikannya: pembandingnya adalah ukuran yang dinyatakan klaim itu sendiri, yaitu 26 persen anggaran federal, tebakan rata-rata yang dicatat jajak pendapat tersebut. Porsi yang disebut jajak pendapat itu sebagai porsi aktual, sekitar 1 persen, dibaca terhadap angka itu dan tampak hanya sebagian kecil darinya, dan keduanya bisa saling dibaca karena sama-sama porsi dari anggaran federal yang sama. Tidak ada jumlah dolar pada kedua batangnya, dan panel itu menyebutkan alasannya: tidak ada sumber dalam registri yang menyebut total anggaran yang menjadi induk porsi-porsi itu, sedangkan penerimaan federal setahun yang dimuat laporan Treasury adalah total yang berbeda dari anggaran belanja yang menjadi induk sebuah porsi anggaran.

q.en: If the line's payments stop, who meets it first, and when?
q.id: Jika pembayaran dari pos itu berhenti, siapa yang menanggungnya lebih dulu, dan kapan?

options.en: Implementing organizations, commodity producers and freight carriers, at the moment payments stop
options.id: Lembaga pelaksana, produsen komoditas, dan pengangkut kargo, pada saat pembayaran berhenti.

options.en: Taxpayers, at the close of the fiscal year, through a narrower deficit
options.id: Pembayar pajak, pada penutupan tahun fiskal, lewat defisit yang menyusut.

options.en: Congress, at the next appropriations cycle

note.en: The claim map treats the cut as a transfer. The line's outlays are at present the income of implementing organizations, commodity producers and freight carriers, and they meet the stopped payments at the moment the cut lands, before any budget total moves. The people the programs serve reach the same point within weeks, while the deficit effect in the final step arrives only with the ledger's year end.
note.id: Peta klaim mencatat belanja pos itu sebagai pendapatan lembaga pelaksana, produsen komoditas, dan pengangkut kargo pada saat ini, sehingga merekalah yang menanggung berhentinya pembayaran pada saat pemangkasan jatuh, sebelum total anggaran mana pun bergeser. Orang-orang yang dilayani program itu sampai pada titik yang sama dalam hitungan pekan, sedangkan efek defisit pada langkah terakhir baru tiba di penghujung tahun buku.

prompt.en: Before you open it: in a claim that runs from foreign aid straight to the deficit, which side do you expect to go unstated?
prompt.id: Sebelum Anda membukanya: dalam klaim yang berjalan dari bantuan luar negeri langsung ke defisit, bagian mana yang menurut Anda tidak disebut?

options.en: The dollar size of the foreign aid line itself
options.id: Besaran belanja tahunan pos bantuan luar negeri itu dalam dolar.

options.en: The size of the deficit it is meant to narrow
options.id: Besarnya defisit yang menurut klaim itu hendak disusutkan.

options.en: Who is currently paid from the line
options.id: Pihak-pihak yang kini dibayar dari pos itu.

options.en: The timing, meaning when a cut actually stops money going out
options.id: Soal waktu, yaitu kapan pemangkasan menghentikan uang yang keluar dari kas.

editorial_notes: Narration: both bundles ship verbatim as authored. No cross-locale fact disagreement was found. Every figure matches across locales: 26 percent, about 1 percent, $5,234.6 billion against US$5.234,6 miliar, 11 percent, 58 percent before and 34 percent after. No edit was needed under any of the four allowed reasons.

Element coverage: the two bundles bind an identical set of 17 el_ids in identical per-sentence groupings, so no panel named by one locale is left uncovered by the other and there is no dangling binding relative to the other authoring.

Panels arbitration was unavailable. slots/usaid-deficit/A9.input.json does not exist in the run directory and no other file in the repository carries these el_ids, so the shipping panels JSON could not be read past the fragment quoted in the reconciler prompt. A reviewer must confirm the panel set contains no el_id outside the 17 the narration binds. If a family marker panel or a non-null echo carries its own el_id, that is an uncovered panel in BOTH locales and needs one sentence per locale. Nothing was invented to close it: a binding to an el_id I could not verify is exactly the fidelity block the gate exists to catch.

Hidden obligated residue: the EN sentence v-4 describes it as signed obligations and goods in transit that keep drawing money after a cut lands, the ID sentence v-4 as signed contract obligations that do not return to the treasury within the running year. Two angles on the same element rather than a contradiction, so both stay verbatim. Flagged because a reviewer with the panel text may want them tightened to one shared description.

Mechanism, base choice: the EN authoring is the base. It opens a dimension neither other move touches, the distance between an appropriation being cut and the Treasury stopping payments. The ID authoring's mechanism asked what crossing the first join requires, which restates the hidden outlay numerator already carried by narration v-3 and overlaps the denominator move. The ID locale was authored natively against the EN base rather than translated.

Mechanism, fidelity trim: the EN base option 1 and its note carried 'termination and close-out costs'. That phrase appears in neither narration and could not be checked against the panels file, so it was cut from both the option and the note, leaving signed obligations and goods already in transit, which both narrations carry. The correct index is unchanged at 1. This is the only edit made to an authored sparring base.

Mechanism, wrong options: option 0 is what a reader assumes, that an appropriation cut stops the outflow the day it takes effect, and it is wrong for a reason the artifact shows afterwards. Option 2 names a procedural step that sounds institutionally plausible but is not what stands between the cut and the payment.

Denominator: EN is the base because it names the move plainly, two share figures against one government-wide total. Both authorings offered the same three option meanings in different order, EN with the receipts total last and ID with it first. EN's order was kept, so correct is 2 in both locales and the ID options were re-authored natively into that order. The ID note from the ID authoring was kept: it settles on the same panel and makes the same point that the deficit figure is recorded as unstated and therefore unavailable for the comparison role.

Incidence: EN is the base for its who-and-when pairing. Options 0 and 1 already matched across authorings. Option 2 diverged, EN offering Congress at the next appropriations cycle and ID offering the poll respondents. The Congress option was kept in both locales because it is the plausible institutional distractor; the poll-respondent option was a category error a reader dismisses without learning anything. Correct index is 0 in both.

Incidence, ID note: the phrase 'sebelum total anggaran mana pun bergeser' was folded from the ID authoring's question into the ID note, since the aligned question no longer carries it. The ID authoring's clinic, supply and distribution specifics were dropped because no narration sentence carries them and the panels file was unavailable to confirm them.

Prediction tap: EN prompt is the base for its pre-reveal framing. Options 0 through 2 matched across authorings. Option 3 diverged, EN offering the timing and ID offering the budget share respondents guessed. Timing was kept in both, because it is a live candidate the mechanism question later settles, whereas the guessed-share option pointed at a figure the poll does state and would have read as the one option to eliminate.

Lexicon: the merged Indonesian copy was checked whole-word and carries no collision. 'salah satu' is absent throughout. 'benar-benar' was deliberately avoided in the new ID sparring copy, because the hyphen leaves 'benar' standing as a whole word to a boundary-based lint; intensifiers were dropped rather than rephrased. Verdict vocabulary is absent from both locales, and no scores appear anywhere.

Future tense: the ID prediction option 1 reads 'hendak disusutkan' rather than 'akan menyusut', keeping the tap clear of forward-looking construction while still naming the deficit the final step aims at.

ID sentence v-6 'menebak jatuh tepat pada porsi aktual itu' reads slightly stiff. It is not a fact disagreement, a dangling binding, a coverage gap or a lexicon violation, so it ships verbatim under the merge rule. Noted here in case a human editor wants the smoother 'jatuh tepat pada porsi aktual itu'.

RE-DISPATCH after both gates blocked, and it supersedes the notes above where they conflict. A Gate C review found the scale check dividing percent-unit segments by a dollar denominator, rendering the two bars as 0.5 percent and 0.0 percent on screen. A7 rebuilt the panel: the denominator is now the claim's own asserted size, the 26 percent average guess, both segments stay in percent, the bars now render 100.0 and 3.8, and the Treasury receipts figure is gone from the panel entirely. The el_id set was preserved, so every binding still resolved, which is why the gates blocked on tracing rather than on bindings: four spans still described the panel as it used to be. Narration v-5 in both locales closed on total federal net receipts for fiscal year 2025, a figure no element carries any more and one the panel's own takeaway now contradicts, since the takeaway states it cannot put a dollar amount on either bar. The denominator sparring item marked that same figure as the answer, so the item was awarding an answer the panel on the same screen refutes. Those four spans, and only those, were rewritten against the panel as it now stands: v-5 in both locales, and the stem, all three options, the correct index and both notes of sparring.questions[1]. The correct index for that item is now 1. What decided the rewrite is the symmetry point: this artifact holds BOTH its claim-map edges missing on the rule that a share may not be read against a total that is not its parent, and the narration was reading the poll's budget shares against a receipts total anyway. The copy does not get to suspend, for itself, the standard the artifact enforces against the claim. The two remaining options on the denominator item are now refutable from the rebuilt panel by a reader: option 0 asks for the Treasury receipts total in dollars and option 2 asks for the federal budget total in dollars, and the panel's takeaway settles both by stating that no dollar amount can sit on either bar because no source in the registry states the budget total the poll's shares are shares of. Two constraints held while rewriting. First, no numeral appears in the new copy that an element does not hold: the ratio the panel renders, 3.8, is described in words as a small part of the size the claim asserts rather than restated as a computed figure, because that number is a render of the two Values and not a Value the graph carries. Second, for the gate owners: the dollar figure sat in prose as a bare numeral with no Value wrapper, so no renderer invariant could have caught it, and prose is exactly where this class of fault hides. A prose-numeral check against the element set would have caught it at authoring time. The stale figure remains inside the first editorial note above, which is a record of the pre-rebuild merge and is left verbatim as the audit trail rather than edited to match the present panel; a reviewer reading that note should read it as history. The 'Panels arbitration was unavailable' note is likewise superseded: the rebuilt panels were read directly this time, from slots/usaid-deficit/candidate.json, which carries two panels, claim_map and scale_check, whose el_ids are exactly the 17 the narration binds, and echo is null.
